definitions.explanation: A heavily fortified military structure or position designed for defense. Used both for historical castles and fortifications and in modern figurative contexts for impregnable places.

examples.japanese: ⟦{敵|てき}→敵：03546_teki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{要塞|ようさい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{攻|せ}める→攻める：02123_semeru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{島|しま}→島：00885_shima⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦かつて→かつて：10303_katsute⟧⟦{軍事|ぐんじ}→軍事：14392_gunji⟧{要塞|ようさい}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{使|つか}われていた→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: This island was once used as a military fortress.

examples.japanese: {難攻不落|なんこうふらく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{要塞|ようさい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ついに⟦{陥落|かんらく}→陥落：14594_kanraku⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。

notes:
USAGE:
{要塞|ようさい} refers specifically to fortified military positions, as opposed to ⟦{城|しろ}→城：03255_shiro⟧ (castle), which may serve as a residence. {要塞|ようさい} emphasizes the defensive, strategic nature of the structure. The word appears frequently in historical, military, and gaming contexts. It can also be used figuratively to describe any extremely well-protected place.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {要塞|ようさい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{築|きず}く→築く：02046_kizuku⟧: to build a fortress
- {要塞|ようさい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{攻略|こうりゃく}する→攻略する：25273_kouryakusuru⟧: to conquer a fortress
- ⟦{軍事|ぐんじ}→軍事：14392_gunji⟧{要塞|ようさい}: military fortress
- {難攻不落|なんこうふらく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{要塞|ようさい}: impregnable fortress
